title: 14. Composition or inheritance?

examples.explanation: Capacity 100 at 3 per meter: 100 // 3 = 33 whole meters. The robot moves 10, then only 23 more.
Two robots share one battery object. The first robot uses 60 charge, so the second can move only 40.
swap_battery returns the empty battery. The robot continues with the full one.

hints: Delegate: the robot asks its battery to `draw` and its motor for the `cost`.
